description: This file defines the TalkAudioPlayer class, a singleton responsible for playing audio data asynchronously, managing playback state, and handling completion and watchdog timers for audio playback control.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayer
classes.description: A singleton class managing audio playback with AVAudioPlayer, including handling of concurrency, watchdog timer, and state management.

classes.name: Playback
classes.description: Inner class to manage the playback state, including continuation handling, timing, and cancellation of watchdog tasks.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Asynchronously plays audio data and returns a result when playback finishes or is interrupted.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops current playback and returns the current time of the playback if available.

methods.name: audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when AVAudioPlayer finishes playing audio.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Internal method to stop playback and update state accordingly.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes playback, cancels watchdog, and resumes the continuation with the result.

methods.name: armWatchdog
methods.description: Sets up a watchdog task that monitors playback duration and cancels playback if it exceeds a timeout.
